extracted.name: Shirley Temple Drink
extracted.description: This Shirley Temple drink lets kids join in the fun with a classic mocktail of orange juice, grenadine, and soda, garnished with a maraschino cherry.
instruction_lines: Combine orange juice and lemon-lime soda in a tall glass. Pour grenadine in and let it sink to the bottom. Garnish with a maraschino cherry and a straw for stirring.
